mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at clear skies and 50 degrees near Badger Prairie County Park, with the waning crescent moon hanging in the sky.

City engineering and pavement repairs continue, with asphalt work set for Tuesday and Wednesday. Additionally, the Plan Commission is meeting on December 7 to review development projects, including plans for Sub-Zero at Liberty Business Park.
We have a busy schedule! Today you can enjoy the Dane County Farmers Market or live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, check out the live music at Wisconsin Brewing Company.

For our weekly report, on October 23, officers made contact with two 13-year-olds riding eMotos on Ashton Drive and subsequently cited their parents for allowing them to operate the prohibited vehicles.
Treat yourself to the Really Reese's flavor of the day at Culver's. The store is currently open and will be serving up scoops until 10:30 PM tonight.
